**What the forecast says.** The system covers next Saturday, January 9, and it is not good news for an outdoor run — rain through the morning, 80% precipitation probability, 44-52°F, with a southerly wind at 12-20 mph. The recommendation on it reads: "Outdoor play is not sensible in this window." Tonight's band is a steady system moving in from the south, so the ground will be wet through the weekend regardless.

**The Rowan Park outdoor courts** run dawn to dusk with no booking and no lights. If the rain is still coming down by morning, the courts will be standing water.

**Indoor backup.** Glenmont does not have a dedicated indoor track or recreation centre listed anywhere in the local directory. Your practical options would be:
- **Rowan Park Tap House** — it is right there at the park, opens at 11:00 on Saturday, carries the out-of-market college package. If the run was going to be a morning thing, that timing does not line up.
- **The branch itself** — if this is a group run, the warehouse floor or the meeting room could host an indoor circuit or stretch-and-coffee session instead. No booking needed and it is dry.
- **Shift the window.** If you can push the run to Saturday afternoon, the forecast shows rain easing after midday. The outdoor courts close at dusk, so there would be a window.

If you want me to look up anything specific — a covered pavilion at the park, or a nearby indoor space you already have in mind — just say the word.
